navigation.import_project_desc: Scan a local project folder into the tree viewer.
navigation.environment_desc: Scan installed runtimes and package managers.

sidebar.init_project_desc: Choose a stack to begin a new project.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize the appearance, language, and behavior of Lazify to fit your workflow.
settings.accent_color_desc: Pick the accent color used across the interface
settings.compact_sidebar_desc: Show only icons in the sidebar navigation
settings.date_format_desc: How dates are displayed in the interface
settings.js_package_manager_desc: Default package manager used for JavaScript projects
settings.package_manager_modal_desc: Choose your preferred JS package manager. Only installed ones can be selected.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Track the project folders this desktop app is allowed to read, keep their stack metadata fresh, and jump back into creation flow when you need a new scaffold.
workspace.projects_desc: Each item stores the approved folder path, detected stack, and the last sync timestamp.
workspace.no_projects_desc: Sync a project folder to let the app remember its path and basic stack details for later workspace access.
workspace.empty_desc: Add a project to start tracking its structure and metadata here.
workspace.empty_long_desc: No project has been synced into this desktop app yet. Add a fresh project from the init flow or sync an existing folder so it appears here.
workspace.sync_error: Unable to sync the selected project.

synced_project.title: Synced Project
synced_project.description: Read the synced project tree and open file contents in the optimized explorer/editor view.
synced_project.not_synced_anymore: This project is not in the synced workspace list anymore. Open it again from Workspace after syncing it.
synced_project.loading: Loading project files and content preview...
synced_project.load_error: Unable to load the selected synced project.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Installed runtimes, package managers, and development tools detected on this machine.

install_tool_modal.title: Install Tool
install_tool_modal.will_run: {{name}} is not installed on this machine. The following command will be run to install it:
install_tool_modal.success_desc: The tool is now available. The environment has been refreshed.
install_tool_modal.failed_desc: Check the output below for details.

update_tool_modal.failed_desc: Check the output below for details.

node_version_modal.title: Node Versions
node_version_modal.nvm_desc: Node Version Manager lets you install and switch between multiple Node.js versions with a single command.
node_version_modal.nvm_empty_desc: nvm is installed but reported no versions. Try installing one with nvm install --lts in your terminal.
node_version_modal.installing_nvm_desc: Running the official install script. This may take a moment.
node_version_modal.nvm_success_desc: Restart the app to start using nvm and manage Node.js versions.
node_version_modal.nvm_failed_desc: Check the output below and try again.

sessions_pane.title: Running Sessions
sessions_pane.empty_desc: Scripts you run from any project will appear here with their ports.

node_version_pane.title: Node Version
node_version_pane.none_pinned_desc: Pick a version from the list to pin it to this project and switch automatically.
node_version_pane.nvm_unavailable_desc: Install nvm from the Environment page to enable per-project Node version switching.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Review saved imported project templates, rename them, edit their file trees, and remove snapshots you no longer want to keep.
templates.empty: No imported templates have been saved yet. Go to Import Project, choose the files to keep, and save the result as a template.
templates.editor_desc: Adjust the saved file tree before reusing this import as a starting point for the next project.
templates.update_error: Unable to update the imported template.
templates.remove_error: Unable to remove the imported template.

console.title: Console
console.description: Inspect every background command Lazify runs, including workflow events, stdout, and errors.

log_panel.title: Live Console
log_panel.subtitle: Streamed directly from the Electron main process.

init_project.title: Init Project
init_project.description_stack: Start fresh with a stack, or switch to a saved imported template.
init_project.description_imported: Choose one of your saved imported templates or switch back to stack-based setup.
init_project.description_structure: Set up the starter file structure before generating the new project.
init_project.start_from_stack_desc: Pick Expo, Next.js, Vite, or another stack and generate a fresh project baseline.
init_project.choose_runtime_first: Choose runtime first, then shape the scaffold before generation.
init_project.use_imported_template_desc: Reuse a previously imported project template saved as JSON from the Import Project flow.
init_project.start_from_template: Start from an approved template snapshot and keep its existing structure.
init_project.no_templates_saved: No imported templates have been saved yet. Use Import Project first, then save one as JSON.

workflow_form.title: Project setup
workflow_form.subtitle: Start by naming the project and pointing Lazify to the base directory before the later workflow steps kick in.
workflow_form.choose_folder: Choose a folder from your operating system
workflow_form.stack_step_desc: This step captures the project name, target directory, and package shortlist.
workflow_form.imported_step_desc: This step captures the project name and target directory for the imported template scaffold.
workflow_form.setup_ready_desc: Continue with the next workflow step.
workflow_form.enter_both: Enter both a project name and workspace directory to continue.

file_structure.title: File structure
file_structure.subtitle: Configure the project tree like a real explorer
file_structure.desc: Your setup config is saved. Now edit the starter structure directly: add files, create folders, rename entries, and reshape the scaffold before generation.

import_project.title: Import Project
import_project.description: Choose a project folder from your machine, scan its files, and inspect the imported structure in the shared project tree.
import_project.skip_notice: Large generated directories like `node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, and `build` are skipped to keep the scan usable.
import_project.empty_prompt: Choose a project folder to scan and load its file tree.
import_project.save_success: Saved template "{{name}}" as JSON with {{count}} file.
import_project.save_success_one: Saved template "{{name}}" as JSON with {{count}} file.
import_project.save_success_other: Saved template "{{name}}" as JSON with {{count}} files.
import_project.import_error: Unable to import the selected project.
import_project.rescan_error: Unable to rescan the selected project.
import_project.save_error: Unable to save the imported template.

package_search.npm_desc: Search the live npm registry and collect multiple packages for installation.
package_search.template_desc: Lazify reads the template manifest and queries the npm searcher so you can review what will be added automatically.
package_search.querying_npm: Querying npm search for template packages...
package_search.no_template_entries: No template package manifest entries were found for this stack.
package_search.search_placeholder: Search npm packages like zustand, react-query, shadcn...
package_search.min_chars: Type at least 2 characters to search npm.
package_search.no_description_returned: No description returned from npm search.
package_search.selected_for_install: Selected for installation in a later workflow step.
package_search.npm_error: Unable to search npm right now.

git_status.title: Commit status
git_status.checking_desc: Lazify is reading uncommitted file changes from Git.
git_status.no_repo_desc: This synced project does not have a readable Git repository at its current path.
git_status.tree_clean_desc: There are no uncommitted file changes in this repository.

package_doctor.title: Package Doctor
package_doctor.empty_desc: Run Doctor to find packages that need updating or downgrading
package_doctor.querying_npm: Querying npm registry for compatible versions…

project_tree.project_contents_desc: Click files from the synced project explorer to read their contents in the editor pane.
project_tree.project_view_title: Inspect and shape the project tree
project_tree.project_view_desc: This view reuses the explorer and editor experience from setup, without module toggles. Use it as a focused project tree workspace for upcoming functionality.
project_tree.explorer_desc: This viewer uses metadata-only scanning, lazy file loading, and virtualized rows so large projects stay responsive.
project_tree.scan_loaded: Scan loaded — folders start collapsed, files load on demand.
project_tree.template_name_placeholder: Template name or leave blank for laz-temp-001
project_tree.select_stack_warning: Select the project stack before saving the template.
project_tree.select_file_from_explorer: Select a file from the explorer
project_tree.structure_modules_title: Select optional folders for the project scaffold
project_tree.structure_modules_desc: Toggle Lazify modules here. Required scaffold folders stay locked, but you can still add more files inside them from the explorer.
project_tree.required_folder_notice: This folder is required by the selected scaffold and cannot be removed.
project_tree.file_content_placeholder: Write the initial file content here...
project_tree.select_file_to_edit: Select a file to edit its contents
project_tree.select_file_to_edit_desc: The explorer stays on the left. Pick any editable file and this panel becomes a large content editor, similar to the main area in VS Code.
project_tree.loading_file_preview_desc: Content is fetched only for the selected file.
project_tree.select_file_to_preview: Select a file to preview its contents
project_tree.select_file_to_preview_desc: Folders are listed in the explorer, but file content is loaded only on demand.

tech_stack_strip.desc: The renderer and desktop shell now share a dedicated icon system.

dependency_pane.title: Dependencies
dependency_pane.empty: No packages installed in this project.
dependency_pane.add_panel_min_chars: Type at least 2 characters to search.
